rows.memory_crash_containment: Strong only under RedLeaf's safe-Rust domain restriction plus trusted compiler/runtime/microkernel and mediated interfaces.
rows.authority_confinement: Domain interface and resource model constrain component interaction; not a general OS security sandbox.
rows.ownership_cleanup: Explicit ownership transfer, liveness, unwinding, resource bookkeeping, and recovery machinery.
rows.reentrancy: Nested cross-domain calls are architected through proxies/continuations; unrestricted component reentrancy is not established.
rows.freshness: Not an analogue of Anneal source/model generation identity.
rows.primary_cost: Specialized language/runtime/interface discipline and trusted mediation.

rows.memory_crash_containment: Prevents safe Rust callers from directly violating wrapped unsafe contracts when abstraction and unsafe implementation are sound; no C crash isolation.
rows.authority_confinement: API-level capability narrowing possible, but same kernel address space and C subsystem authority remain.
rows.ownership_cleanup: RAII plus explicit unsafe foreign ownership protocols can localize lifetime obligations.
rows.reentrancy: Per-abstraction property; not implied by wrapper safety.
rows.primary_cost: Review and maintenance of wrapper soundness and explicit unsafe contracts.

rows.memory_crash_containment: Address-space/process-lifetime boundary independent of implementation language, within OS guarantees.
rows.authority_confinement: Ambient by default; sandboxing requires separate policy.
rows.ownership_cleanup: Private memory reclaimed on exit; child processes/files/external effects require explicit management.
rows.reentrancy: Service/protocol-specific; one-shot subprocess can serialize by construction.
rows.freshness: Must be enforced separately by generation/source/environment identity and publication fencing.
rows.primary_cost: IPC, serialization, startup, duplicated runtime/caches, process supervision.

anneal_conditional_judgment: Default opaque execution backends to subprocesses; use narrow checked host adapters for environment preparation/publication; share immutable artifacts; move a backend in-process only after its mutable state, FFI surface, reset, cancellation, and reentrancy contract are explicit and independently retain result-identity fencing.
